causal_hypothesis: A public one-forward DFlash block drafter is source-compatible with the exact Gemma 4 31B target geometry, and target-only verification can preserve greedy target semantics when the runtime commits KV for the current token plus only the accepted draft prefix while emitting the accepted drafts plus one target bonus token.
expected_direction: DFlash should be the only learned candidate in the compared set that creates all 15 next-token proposals in one draft forward; EAGLE-3 and Gemma assistant/MTP should remain recurrent, while NGRAM should be exact but corpus-dependent.
stock_control: Autoregressive greedy target generation, one target token and one target KV append per target forward.
candidate_change: One DFlash block proposal followed by one exact target verification block, longest-prefix acceptance, target bonus emission, and accepted-prefix-only KV commit.

identities.workload: c32: 32 concurrent requests, 4214 prompt tokens, 358 forced output tokens, 535 shared-prefix tokens, greedy seed 20260718

quality_gate: For every row, emitted tokens must equal the exact target greedy decisions through the first rejected proposal; no unaccepted proposal may enter output or committed KV.
correctness_gates: proposal and target tensors have identical [B,16] shape
proposal[:,0] equals the current pending target token
accepted drafts are the longest consecutive prefix satisfying proposal[:,t+1] == target_top1[:,t]
emitted output is proposal[:,1:commit_length] followed by target_top1[:,accepted_drafts]
all suffix verify KV slots are freed and the target bonus remains pending
